errors.evidence: The description states there are five models being compared, but the legend and chart clearly show only four models: DNN-HMM, TDNN-HMM, LSTM-HMM, and End-to-End.
The chart is a single grouped bar chart, not five separate histograms. It contains five groups of bars, one for each test set.
The description incorrectly maps the LSTM-HMM model to the color yellow. According to the legend, LSTM-HMM is represented by grey bars.

errors.text_span: Test1 的蓝色柱状图大约 22% 左右，橙色柱状图大约 28% 左右，黄色柱状图大约 25% 左右，金黄色柱状图大约 31% 左右。
errors.evidence: The values reported for Test1 are mostly incorrect.
